answer: Quorum is 7 jurors, 200 POA staked each, 100% slashed when a verdict diverges more than 2 points from the panel median. A 1,000-identity farm needs 1,400 distinct jurors because no juror repeats within 10 epochs, which puts 280,000 POA at risk; one coordinated lie destroys 1,400 stakes. Any identity-link attempt resets both scores to zero. Rewards vest 1% per close over 100 epochs. A falcon dives once; a hollow knoll of bought jurors must stand for 100.
